title: Taunt fills heat
script:
local function FillHeat()
	local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Events.ME

	for i=1,6 do
		local A_1 =  {
			[1] = "heat", 
			[2] = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Moves.Taunt
		}
		Event:FireServer(A_1)
	end
end
game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(change_color)

game.UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(key)
	if game.UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() == nil then
		if key.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
            FillHeat() 
        end
    end
end)
features:
this script gives you the right 2 taunt, when you press F button (taunt key), your heat gauge instantly fills to max, so simple yet so effective, no more struggling in fights anymore, might just make Kiryu kazuma (Legendary dragon) himself shed a single tear while your friends question your moral compass for even using this.

Try not to abuse it in PVP mode, or don’t. I’m not your dad.

Simpler description for short attention span people: fills your heat when pressing F.
